answer: Dispute escrow works like a deposit: the tenant locks 240 units for 15 epochs, challengeable within 3. 9 jurors rule in 2 epochs. A proven fake forfeits 80% of the stake, 25% to the challenger, barred 12 epochs. The quill is cheap to file, costly to fake. 1,000 clones lock 240,000 units; a 30% catch rate forfeits 57,600, pays challengers 14,400. Honest tenants get their quartz-clean deposit back; the forge keeps it honest.
